summary: # Image-Text Posting (贴图发表, formerly 图文) WeChat renamed "图文" to "贴图" in the Official Account menu (2026). ## Usage ```bash # Title/content extracted from markdown ${BUN_X} ./scripts/wechat-browser.ts --markdown source.md --images ./images/ # Explicit title and content ${BUN_X} ./scripts/wechat-browser.ts --title "标题" --content "内容" --image img1.png --image img2.png # Save as draft ${BUN_X} ./scripts/wechat-browser.ts --markdown source.md --images ./images/ --submit
